en.t: What was this, what was happening! ...

units.source_text: 男人惊慌失措，全身伏倒在地面上……

en.t: The man panicked and threw himself flat on the ground ...

units.source_text: 实在太唐突了，他一下子无法应付眼前的情况……

en.t: It had come so suddenly that he could not deal with the situation before him at once ...

units.source_text: 忽然，村落的全景展现在他眼前！……

en.t: Suddenly, the whole village spread out before his eyes! ...

units.source_text: 他好像面对着连接村落的沙丘之峰，转了个直角走来的……

en.t: It seemed he had been facing the ridge of dunes that led to the village, then had turned at a right angle and walked on ...

units.source_text: 就在视野开阔的一刹那，他其实已经走进村落里来了……

en.t: At the very instant his view opened up, he had in fact already entered the village ...

units.source_text: 还来不及判断，眼前粗糙的土墙周围，传来充满敌意的狗叫声。

en.t: Before he had time to make sense of it, hostile barking came from around the rough earthen walls in front of him.

units.source_text: 接着，一条狗，又一条狗，引起了惊人的连锁反应，迅速铺开。

en.t: Then one dog, then another, set off an astonishing chain reaction that spread rapidly.

units.source_text: 幽暗中，狗咯嗒咯嗒，呲牙咧嘴，一点点逼近。

en.t: In the gloom, the dogs clacked their teeth, bared their fangs, and edged closer little by little.

units.source_text: 男人抽出一头系着剪刀的绳索，跳起来，撒腿就跑。

en.t: The man pulled out the rope with the scissors tied to one end, sprang up, and ran for his life.

units.source_text: 已经没有选择余地了，往后只有迎着村子的出口跑了，这是最短的路线！

en.t: There was no choice left; from here he could only run toward the village exit. It was the shortest route!
